title: The photon
body: Public edition. Real-world reference information, fact-checked. A photon is the particle of light with energy E = h times f, where h is Planck's constant (6.62607015e-34 J s). Photons have no mass and always move at light speed. Every color of light is a stream of photons. title: Light and DNA
body: Public edition. Real-world reference information, fact-checked. Ultraviolet light can damage DNA by fusing neighboring thymine bases into dimers, which can cause mutations. Cells repair this with enzymes, and some organisms use photolyase, which itself uses visible light to fix the damage. Light both harms and heals DNA.
